title: Dust, Noise, and the Opening Clash at Patiala

blocks.text: The battle begins in sensory confusion and violent momentum. The sun seemed to have been eclipsed by the rising dust, while drums, musketry, and shouted commands spread panic around Patiala before either side could claim a clear advantage.

Amar Singh tries to convert his numerical confidence into a decisive charge, urging his troops to kill the Singhs and seize their horses. Yet once the lines close, the Khalsa steadies itself under fire and answers with disciplined shooting that checks repeated advances.

The page presents the first great testing of appearance against reality. What looked like an overwhelming host is forced to meet veteran resistance at close quarters, and the promise of a quick victory begins to fray.
